name: Identifiers across reinstall (IDFV, App Set ID)
plain: Vendor scoped ids stay stable across reinstalls until every app from that developer is removed.
meaning: IDFV and App Set ID let one developer recognise a device across its own apps. They reset when the last app from that vendor is deleted, and App Set ID also after long disuse.

android.persistence: Reset on uninstall of all apps from the developer account and after about 13 months of non use (docs, from memory)
android.revocation: Cannot be reset by the user
android.store_policy: Play: only permitted ids for ads and analytics
android.note: Scope is app or developer; 13 month inactivity reset

ios.persistence: Persists while any app from the vendor remains; changes when all are removed
ios.revocation: Delete all apps of the vendor
ios.store_policy: App Store: not for ad tracking without ATT
ios.note: Same value for every app from one vendor on a device; reset after the last vendor app is deleted

limits.headline: Can recognise your phone after you reinstall, across one developer's apps
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the app starts
can: Keep the same ID after you delete and reinstall one app
Give the same value to every app from one developer
Keep the ID on Android until 13 months of no use
cannot: Follow you into other companies' apps
Stay after you delete every app from that developer
Stay the same after 13 months of no use (App Set ID)
limits.differs: iPhone calls it IDFV and Android calls it App Set ID. Android also resets it after 13 months idle.

story.what_it_is: Numbers that identify your phone to one developer and survive a delete and reinstall.

marketing.name: Identifier for Vendor
marketing.pitch: The same for all of a developer's apps on a device, resets when all are deleted.

story.for_you: You delete an app and later install it again. The company can still tell it is you, unless you deleted every app from that developer.
story.for_makers: IDFV and App Set ID let one developer recognize a device across its own apps. They reset when the last app from that vendor is deleted, so a clean reset needs more than one deletion.

use_cases.example: A game gives a welcome bonus once. Deleting and reinstalling does not reset it.
A fraud team notices that a banned user reinstalled and blocks the account.
A retailer keeps your cart after a reinstall on the same device.
A product team counts reinstalls as the same user, not a new one.
A workout app restores your streak after you reinstall.
A tracker tried to join this ID with other signals, which Apple's rules ban.

story.android_note: Android App Set ID resets after 13 months idle or when all apps are removed.
story.ios_note: iOS IDFV resets when the last app from the vendor is removed.

technical_bounds: Cleared when last app is removed

legit_uses: Anonymous analytics across a family of apps

history.change: App Set ID API launched as a replacement for resettable ad identity use cases
